attributes.label: Vigor
attributes.text: Attribute governing HP. Also affects fire resistance and immunity.

attributes.label: Mind
attributes.text: Attribute that determines FP. Also affects focus.

attributes.label: Endurance
attributes.text: Attribute governing stamina. Also affects robustness. This attribute also determines how heavy your equipment can be.

attributes.label: Strength
attributes.text: Attribute required to wield heavy armaments. Also boosts attack power of strength-scaling armaments and affects your physical defense.

attributes.label: Dexterity
attributes.text: Attribute required to wield advanced armaments. Also boosts attack power of dexterity-scaling armaments, reduces casting time of spells, softens fall damage, and makes it harder to be knocked off your horse.

attributes.label: Intelligence
attributes.text: Attribute required to perform glintstone sorceries. Also boosts magic power of intelligence-scaling sorceries and improves magic resistance.

attributes.label: Faith
attributes.text: Attribute required to perform sacred incantations. Also boosts magic power of faith-scaling incantations.

attributes.label: Arcane
attributes.text: Attribute governing discovery. Also affects holy defense, vitality, and certain sorceries and incantations.

derived.label: HP
derived.text: Your life. If reduced to nothing, you die. Replenish it by drinking from the Flask of Crimson Tears or resting at a site of grace.

derived.label: FP
derived.text: Energy consumed to use spells and skills. Replenish it by drinking from the Flask of Cerulean Tears or resting at a site of grace.

derived.label: Stamina
derived.text: Required for various actions. Depletes when certain actions are taken, but recovers automatically.

derived.label: Equip Load
derived.text: Total weight of equipped armaments and armor. Movement slows as load increases. The rightmost number is the maximum weight that can be equipped; exceed it and movement slows dramatically.

derived.label: Max Equip Load
derived.text: Max weight of equippable armaments and armor. Movement slows as load increases. Exceed this number and movement slows dramatically.

defence.label: Physical
defence.text: The body's capacity to endure standard physical damage

defence.label: Strike
defence.text: The body's capacity to endure striking physical damage

defence.label: Slash
defence.text: The body's capacity to endure slashing physical damage

defence.label: Pierce
defence.text: The body's capacity to endure piercing physical damage

defence.label: Magic
defence.text: The body's capacity to endure magical damage

defence.label: Fire
defence.text: The body's capacity to endure fire damage

defence.label: Lightning
defence.text: The body's capacity to endure lightning damage

defence.label: Holy
defence.text: The body's capacity to endure holy damage

resistance.label: Immunity
resistance.text: The body's capacity to resist various poisons and rot. Higher values make it more difficult to succumb to these ailments.

resistance.label: Robustness
resistance.text: The body's capacity to resist blood loss and frostbite. Higher values make it more difficult to succumb to these ailments.

resistance.label: Focus
resistance.text: The body's capacity to resist sleep and bouts of madness. Higher values make it more difficult to succumb to these ailments.

resistance.label: Vitality
resistance.text: The body's capacity to resist death. Higher values make it more difficult to be afflicted with instant death.

progression.label: Level
progression.text: A cumulative figure that represents overall attribute strength. You can level up using runes.

progression.label: Runes
progression.text: Total runes in possession. Upon dying, you will drop any runes in your possession at the site of your death.

progression.label: Runes to Next Level
progression.text: Number of runes required to raise a level. When you level up, you can choose an attribute to increase.

progression.label: Great Runes
progression.text: The number of Great Runes in your possession

progression.label: Scadutree Blessing
progression.text: Strength of the Scadutree Blessing. Affects only those within the realm of shadow who have received the Scadutree Blessing.

progression.label: Revered Spirit Ash Blessing
progression.text: Strength of the Revered Spirit Ash Blessing. Enhances summoned spirits and spectral steed, but only while within the bounds of the realm of shadow.

inscriptions.text: Guide and gatekeeper for those returning to the roots

inscriptions.title: Impenetrable thorns refuse all.
inscriptions.text: None may enter the Erdtree.
Here lie Aurelia and Aureliette, who never saw the stars
Seek three wise beasts
Endow the eyes of the mask in light
Seek three wise beasts
Seek three great wise beasts
Access to those outside of the royal family is strictly forbidden
Touch three phantom crests
Falling snow marks something unseen
Light the four figures in the evergaol

inscriptions.title: Godrick the Golden, humiliated
inscriptions.text:
Having tasted defeat by the Blade of Miquella
Now on his knees, begging for mercy

inscriptions.title: Lord Godfrey, at last at the end of his campaign
inscriptions.text:
His golden armies unvanquished and unbowed
Yet finds grace lost, tattered and faded

inscriptions.title: The siege of Castle Morne
inscriptions.text:
A lone hero fights for his vengeance
Only to fall at the hand of Lord Godfrey

inscriptions.title: This marks Malenia's southward march
inscriptions.text:
The Blade of Miquella and her Cleanrot Knights
Grant her wings never to be clipped

inscriptions.title: The Second Liurnian War
inscriptions.text:
No victory for the golden, nor for the moon
No prize but atonement; the birth of a vow

inscriptions.title: The resting place of the contemptible Cuckoos
inscriptions.text: Lost in the siege of Caria Manor

inscriptions.title: The First Liurnian War
inscriptions.text: Radagon's glory burns red as his hair

inscriptions.title: The Routing of the Ancient Dragons
inscriptions.text:
Godwyn the Golden fought to the last,
Earning the friendship of dread Fortissax

inscriptions.title: The First Defense of Leyndell
inscriptions.text:
A sovereign alliance rots from within
Traces yet remain of bloody conspiracy

inscriptions.title: The Second Defense of Leyndell
inscriptions.text:
The Fell Omen stacks high the corpses of heroes
Yet the Erdtree remains unshaken

inscriptions.title: The Assault on Volcano Manor
inscriptions.text:
The squalid, the sick, the blasphemous;
a wretched, unending war with no glory

inscriptions.title: The Battle of Aeonia
inscriptions.text:
Radahn and Malenia locked in stalemate
Then, the scarlet rot blooms

inscriptions.title: The Starscourge Conflict
inscriptions.text:
Radahn alone holds Sellia secure
And stands tall, to shatter the stars

inscriptions.title: The War against the Giants
inscriptions.text:
Champions battle, trolls betray
Fire vanquished, the era of the Erdtree begins
